name: B10-0510/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to do more about Myanmar. It condemns the military regime's violence and rejects the elections the junta plans for late 2025 and early 2026. It asks for more aid to displaced people and Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh, new sanctions on the military and its banks, support for the democratic opposition, and justice for crimes committed. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to add sanctions on Myanmar's military, banks and aviation fuel sales.
- Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh would get more EU aid, resettlement places and support.
- The Parliament urges other countries to reject the junta's planned elections and back justice efforts.
